cards.complexityReason: SUBMIT mode changes workflow state, creates a WorkflowTask, writes WorkflowHistory and OutboxMessage, mutates multiple aggregates atomically (Ask, AskVersion, WorkflowInstance, WorkflowTask, WorkflowDecision, WorkflowHistory, AskComment, AskAttachmentLink), and calls external reference-data and employee services for validation.

differences.masterLldValue: /api/v1/asks (versioned prefix, plural unqualified resource name per MLLD 15 and REST conventions)

differences.item: HTTP status code for business rule violations (fteAmount > headCountAmount, date constraints)
differences.specValue: 422 Unprocessable Entity (AC5, AC7, Error Behaviour section)
differences.masterLldValue: 400 validation_failed — 422 is not present in the approved error catalogue (MLLD 12.2)
Not explicitly resolved in Master LLD; 201 is conventional for POST resource creation under REST contract (API 001)

differences.item: buttonValue=Exit no-op on a POST endpoint
differences.specValue: POST /core-asks with buttonValue=Exit returns success without persisting any data (FR6, AC4)
differences.masterLldValue: Master LLD catalogue separates create (POST /api/v1/asks) from submit (POST /api/v1/asks/{id}/submit); a no-op POST is not a pattern in the approved catalogue

differences.item: Combined create-and-submit in a single endpoint
differences.specValue: Single POST /core-asks handles Save & Exit (draft), SUBMIT (workflow start), and Exit (no-op) via buttonValue (FR4, FR5, FR6, BR23)
differences.masterLldValue: Master LLD proposes separate POST /api/v1/asks (create draft) and POST /api/v1/asks/{id}/submit (start workflow) operations (MLLD 15)

differences.item: Workflow routing states referenced by numeric ID
differences.specValue: Status 123 (In Progress / draft), 127 (PPL Review), 145 (DPP Ops Review) used as routing targets (FR4, FR5, BR24, BR25, BR26)
differences.masterLldValue: Master LLD and state-transition document use named states: Draft, Pending PPL Approval, Pending Additional Approval, Pending Leadership Approval, Completed, Cancelled — numeric IDs are not mapped

assumptions: buttonValue=Exit is treated as a server-side no-op returning success without any persistence — confirmed in spec Assumptions section but unusual for a POST; Solution Architecture to confirm this pattern is acceptable or whether the client should simply not call the endpoint.

Attachment file-upload contract is represented as a documents array in the JSON body — confirmed in spec Assumptions section; multipart vs. JSON base64 encoding is not resolved and is an open item for the API Contract owner.
Leadership group membership is determinable from the server-side DRT actor context at request time — unconfirmed in spec; recorded as a missing fact for Security.
The 'new-version only' fields (pml, titlingCategory, transitionalCoach) are applicable to initial creation in this story — unconfirmed; recorded as a missing fact for Business Analysis.

Numeric status IDs 123, 127, 145 correspond to Draft/In Progress, Pending PPL Approval, and a DPP Ops routing state respectively — unconfirmed mapping; recorded as a missing fact for Business Analysis.
